historical_adaptations.rationale: The canonical JP override owns the shared Sigma search interaction. Remove its generated base copy so the final source has one owner and stable cascade order. This transform requires the exact generated rule exactly once and fails closed if that source changes; on an upstream update, review whether the search behavior remains necessary and keep the rule in one layer.

historical_adaptations.marker: SCP-JP Wikidot tablet sidebar: contain documented literal HTML-block preview source while preserving horizontal access.
historical_adaptations.rationale: Wikidot PagePreview keeps HTML blocks literal. Keep a long literal frame source within the tablet sidebar while preserving horizontal access; the rule is media-limited and removes no content.

historical_adaptations.marker: SCP-JP Wikidot space credit view: keep the credit modal on the theme dark ground so the body text stays readable.
historical_adaptations.rationale: In the heritage credit composition the frozen credit-component sheet paints [id*=u-credit] div.modalbox with background rgb(var(--modal-bg)) !important; space defines no --modal-bg, so on the SCP-JP target the modal body resolves light (measured rgb(244,244,244)) while the modal text inherits the theme white body color, a measured contrast of 1.1 (defect Q1-11). The theme modal design is the dark void ground with light text, and the source already gives #u-credit-otherwise exactly that treatment. The same-target delta receipt shows re-asserting the dark ground for the credit view modal raises the body-text contrast to 17.82 at 320-1440px with no collateral geometry change.

historical_adaptations.marker: SCP-JP Wikidot space credit rate bar: keep the module layout inside the credit modals so the bar shares its row with the license badge instead of overlapping it.
historical_adaptations.rationale: The candidate-authored :is(div,ul).creditRate block rule (candidate.css L490-495) forces the credit rate bar to a full-width block inside the credit view modal, where it overlaps the CC license badge (Sigma-10 defect S10B-1, rows 43/44). The credit module layout is inline-flex floated right, sharing the row with the badge. This block restores the module layout inside the credit modals only; the page-level rate bar keeps the theme block layout. The Sigma-9 delta frame cannot host the Sigma-10 modal DOM (the fixture modal has no .creditRate element), so verification is assigned to the Sigma-10 recapture; the isolation and frame limitation are recorded in the cited note.

historical_adaptations.marker: SCP-JP Wikidot space top bar: keep submenus closed on keyboard focus alone, matching the runtime default menu behavior.
historical_adaptations.rationale: The flattened Sigma Plus include opens top-bar submenus on :focus-within (candidate.css L213-215), so keyboard focus alone opens a desktop dropdown; the runtime default does not open on focus (Sigma-10 defect S10B-3). The same-target delta receipt shows this block keeps the submenu closed on focus at 1024/1440px while hover opening is preserved; JS-driven .sfhover opening is excluded from the suppression.

historical_adaptations.marker: SCP-JP Wikidot space credit modals: give the credit modal box a definite width at mobile widths so the otherwise columns do not collapse and the rate bar clears the license badges.
historical_adaptations.rationale: In the Sigma-10 shell the credit modal box shrink-wraps its content inside the grid-centered container: the otherwise box measured 149px wide with a 66px content column at a 390px viewport, so the credit data collapsed to one or two characters per line (S10B-2), and in the credit view the rate bar reached the license-badge corner (S10B-1; the pre-freeze credit-rate correction block is present in the candidate but insufficient in this composition). Giving the modal box a definite width at mobile widths — min(36rem, 100vw - 2rem) — restores the full-width otherwise layout and separates the rate bar from the badges. W13 delta evidence: acceptance-frame captures before/after in the S10 shell (otherwise bc956c07… -> 26081f4e…, view 723d8ce9… -> 1bbb0a90…), narrow-mobile verified, and the S9 shell mobile frames re-captured well-formed with the block.

historical_adaptations.marker: SCP-JP Wikidot space narrow history: keep the revision table inside the viewport at phone widths.
historical_adaptations.rationale: G2-08 (D6 family): at 320px the revision table's container measures 331px wide and the comment column is clipped at the viewport edge. The block caps the history container at the viewport width and gives the table a fixed layout at full width with anywhere wrapping, so every column stays inside the viewport and all revision data remains readable (narrow columns wrap hard; two softer distributions were measured and rejected — auto layout collapses the columns pathologically). Acceptance-frame delta: ec2b1c11... (331px, clipped) -> ac982b5a... (280px, complete).
